name: 固有表現の一貫性
description: 評価します the consistency and factual 精度 of named entities (people, places, dates) を検出するために AI hallucinations and fabricated content.
useCase: AI生成テキストの検出 through inconsistent or hallucinated named entities
mechanism: 抽出します named entities using NER models, then checks for internal consistency (same entity referenced with conflicting attributes), temporal plausibility (dates and events alignment), and cross-referencing density. AI生成の text is prone to 'hallucination'—generating plausible-sounding but factually incorrect entity mentions or mixing attributes 間の different entities.
accuracy: 中-高 - 76-86% on factual text domains
source: Ji, Z. et al. (2023) - Survey of Hallucination in Natural Language Generation, ACM Computing Surveys
algorithm: Named Entity Recognition + Consistency Graph + Conflict Detection
parameters: NER model: transformer-based, Entity types: PER/ORG/LOC/DATE/NUM, Consistency check: pairwise attribute comparison, 閾値: 適応型 per entity type
strengths:
• AIの幻覚問題を直接的にターゲット
• 事実に基づく文書での高精度
• 解釈可能なエラー例
• ニュースや学術テキストに有効
limitations:
• Requires domain knowledge for fact-checking
• Creative fiction has naturally inconsistent entities
• NER model errors propagate to 分析
• Less useful for opinion or abstract text

references.title: Ji, Z. et al. (2023). Survey of Hallucination in Natural Language Generation. ACM Computing Surveys.
Manakul, P. et al. (2023). SelfCheckGPT: Zero-Resource Black-Box Hallucination Detection for Generative LLMs. EMNLP.
Min, S. et al. (2023). FActScore: Fine-grained Atomic Evaluation of Factual Precision. EMNLP.
